title: AWKUM Conducts First Day of Faculty Training on Blackboard LMS
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) conducted the first day
of faculty training on the Blackboard Learning Management System (LMS) at the
Central Library Conference Hall, Garden Campus.

The training program was organized by the University’s ERP Cell
following the acquisition of the Blackboard LMS from the Higher Education
Commission (HEC) under the ERP framework. The initiative is aimed at
strengthening digital teaching, learning, and assessment practices in line with
contemporary academic standards.

Faculty members representing various academic departments
participated in the training sessions, which focused on course creation and
management, online teaching tools, assessment mechanisms, and strategies for
enhancing student engagement through the Blackboard platform.

The University administration acknowledged and appreciated the
support of the competent authority, Deans, Heads of Departments, faculty
members, IT Team, Central Library administration, meeting Section, and the
Registrar and Treasurer Offices for their cooperation in ensuring the
successful and smooth conduct of the training program.

Further training sessions will be conducted as per the approved
schedule.
